cases.query: A disguised highborn child bloodies a baker's orphan with a wooden practice sword after he tries to steal her real blade.
cases.rationale: Arya breaks Hot Pie's nose while travelling north in disguise.

cases.query: A girl running from a burning holdfast throws an axe into a locked wagon so three dangerous prisoners can escape.
cases.rationale: Arya gives Jaqen, Rorge, and Biter the means to escape their burning cage.

cases.query: An injured boy asks an enemy soldier to carry him, and the soldier answers by driving a spear through his throat.
cases.rationale: Polliver kills Lommy after Lommy says that he must be carried.

cases.query: A young smith sees through a supposed recruit's disguise because she always goes into the woods alone to urinate.
cases.rationale: Gendry tells Arya that he knows she is a girl.

cases.query: The new chief minister removes the corrupt commander of the city watch by putting him on a ship bound for the Wall.
cases.rationale: Tyrion sends Janos Slynt into exile with the Night's Watch.

cases.query: Three different marriage plans are leaked to three councillors so the acting Hand can identify which one informs the queen.
cases.rationale: Tyrion reveals that only Pycelle received the true Dornish proposal.

cases.query: A drunken former knight tells a captive girl to meet him secretly beside the heart tree because nowhere else in the castle is safe.
cases.rationale: Dontos establishes the godswood as the place for his meetings with Sansa.

cases.query: An unusually tall woman is the last rider mounted after defeating more than a hundred knights in a royal melee.
cases.rationale: Brienne wins Renly's melee at Bitterbridge.

cases.query: A young princess is publicly promised to the heir of Dorne as part of an alliance negotiated by her uncle.
cases.rationale: The court announces Myrcella's betrothal to Trystane Martell.

cases.query: A returning heir learns that the woman he flirted with on the road is actually the sister he has not seen since childhood.
cases.rationale: Balon identifies Asha after she has travelled with Theon under another name.

cases.query: A swamp lord's daughter uses a net and three-pronged spear while play-fighting a direwolf.
cases.rationale: Meera Reed demonstrates her net-fighting against Summer.

cases.query: A prophetic boy explains that his visions are always true even though their symbolic form can be misunderstood.
cases.rationale: Jojen distinguishes the truth of green dreams from their difficult interpretation.

cases.query: A landlocked castle is swallowed by black waves and salt water in a boy's prophetic dream.
cases.rationale: Jojen describes the sea coming over Winterfell's walls.

cases.query: In a green dream, a foul-smelling prisoner stands over two dead brothers and cuts the faces from them.
cases.rationale: Jojen foresees Reek's role in the apparent deaths of Bran and Rickon.

cases.query: During failed peace talks, a younger king unnerves his grim brother by casually offering him a piece of fruit.
cases.rationale: Renly produces and offers Stannis a peach during their parley.

cases.query: Brothers on an ancient hill uncover black glass weapons wrapped with an old horn beneath the snow.
cases.rationale: Jon and Ghost find the buried dragonglass and warhorn at the Fist.

cases.query: A claimant walks into a burning pyre of wooden gods and pulls a glowing ceremonial sword from the flames.
cases.rationale: Stannis draws the staged Lightbringer from the burning idols.

cases.query: A priestess challenges a sailor's faith by saying that his wife, not a wooden goddess, gave him seven sons.
cases.rationale: Melisandre disputes Davos's claim that the Mother blessed his family.

cases.query: A pregnant daughter-wife begs a young watchman to take her away, but he says their dangerous expedition cannot protect her child.
cases.rationale: Jon refuses Gilly's request to escape with the ranging.

cases.query: A young ranger raises his sword over a kneeling captive but cannot execute her and instead tells her to run.
cases.rationale: Jon lowers Longclaw and releases Ygritte.

cases.query: After a mob attack, an uncle loses his temper and kicks the young king until a white knight pulls him away.
cases.rationale: Tyrion attacks Joffrey after the riot until Mandon Moore intervenes.

cases.query: The king orders a guardsman to tear open his betrothed's dress after having her beaten for her brother's victory.
cases.rationale: Boros Blount strips Sansa on Joffrey's order.

cases.query: Terrified by the wildfire outside the gate, a wounded warrior refuses both the king and his chief minister and abandons the battle.
cases.rationale: The Hound refuses Tyrion's order to lead another sortie into the fire.

cases.query: A wrongly accused young woman, bruised and bleeding because of a queen's threat, kisses the man whose real lover she protected.
cases.rationale: Alayaya kisses Tyrion after Cersei has her beaten as leverage.

cases.query: A quiet squire saves his wounded master by knocking a treacherous white knight from one ship into the river.
cases.rationale: Podrick Payne pushes Mandon Moore into the Blackwater before he can kill Tyrion.

cases.query: A man changes his face, gives a girl an iron coin, and teaches her a foreign phrase meaning that everyone must die.
cases.rationale: Jaqen says farewell to Arya and has her repeat valar morghulis.

cases.query: A displaced queen asks the hereditary rulers of a merchant city for ships and soldiers but receives only ceremonial courtesy.
cases.rationale: Daenerys pleads her case before Qarth's Pureborn.

cases.query: Inside a vision, a sweet-smelling blue flower grows from a crack in an enormous wall of ice.
cases.rationale: Daenerys sees the blue flower in the Wall during the House of the Undying visions.

cases.query: Two strangers sent by a wealthy cheesemonger offer a silver-haired queen three ships to return west.
cases.rationale: Belwas and Arstan reveal that Illyrio has hired ships for Daenerys.

cases.query: A prisoner advises a desperate prince to flay two children so their bodies can be passed off as missing heirs.
cases.rationale: Reek suggests removing the faces during the search for Bran and Rickon.

cases.query: While imprisoned, a knight calmly admits to a boy's mother that he threw her son from a tower window.
cases.rationale: Jaime tells Catelyn directly that he pushed Bran.

cases.query: Before escaping a haunted castle, a girl creeps into the smithy at night and wakes an apprentice sleeping beside two others.
cases.rationale: Arya wakes Gendry to recruit him for her escape from Harrenhal.

cases.query: A brutal steward is mysteriously killed when the spotted dog he raised tears open his throat in the castle yard.
cases.rationale: Jaqen fulfils Arya's second death by making Weese's own dog kill him.

cases.query: After discovering a flirtatious travelling companion was his sister, a prince tells her he preferred the false identity she used.
cases.rationale: Theon tells Asha that he liked her better as Esgred.

cases.query: A drunken fool asks his little songbook heroine for a lucky kiss while claiming he will arrange her escape.
cases.rationale: Dontos asks Sansa, whom he calls Jonquil, to kiss her Florian.
